answer: A bond of 37% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in atlas, and lotus reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 152 aliases, and each one needs its own funded velvet account. The attacker spends 262 dollars and 3 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
